name: Star Wars Zero Company: Deluxe Edition
storyline: Set during the final year of the Clone Wars, this tactical adventure follows Hawks, a disgraced former Galactic Republic captain who took the blame for a devastating defeat against the Separatists. Cast out of military service, Hawks now leads Zero Company, a ragtag band of misfits and mercenaries operating from a hideout known as the Den on the Ring of Kafrene. Deep in debt to the Hutts, the company scrapes by on dangerous contracts, its members bound together as much by circumstance as loyalty. Everything changes when a mission brings them face to face with the Infinite Coil, a sinister Separatist-aligned cult whose followers are twisted by a mysterious affliction called the Shadow Plague. Recognizing the threat, Republic Intelligence recruits Zero Company to hunt the cult across the galaxy and stop its enigmatic leader before the plague can spread. Managing their crew, gear, and fragile alliances, Hawks and the company are drawn into a war far larger than themselves.
